subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should iPhone root navigation permanently replace the tab bar and Control hub with this all-destinations sidebar shell after the session-roster completeness defect is fixed?
rationale: This is a broad, irreversible user-navigation change across the iOS app, and the protected `maintainer` label means the available PR description is not a substitute for an explicit acceptance decision.

options.title: Approve the sidebar direction
options.body: Confirm the permanent sidebar-only navigation model, contingent on paginating or clearly bounding the session data before merge.

options.title: Retain a phone-specific root path
options.body: Keep or redesign a compact tab/control navigation path if the full sidebar drawer should not become the sole iPhone root-navigation model.

recommendation.title: Approve the sidebar direction
recommendation.body: Confirm the permanent sidebar-only navigation model, contingent on paginating or clearly bounding the session data before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related Overview-retirement direction and this implementation both originate from steipete, providing the clearest available product-routing signal.
